componentId.title: Component ID
componentId.description: Number identifying the DPP; format and assignment of the ID are not prescribed by Swiss Inv

ebkphCode.title: eBKP-H code
ebkphCode.description: According to eBKP-H SN 506 511; code and label are to be given in separate data fields; a selection of possible codes is listed in the eBKP-H reference table

ebkphLabel.title: eBKP-H label
ebkphLabel.description: Label belonging to the eBKP-H code; code and label are to be given in separate data fields

positionInDonorBuilding.title: Position in donor building
positionInDonorBuilding.description: Description of the position in the donor building, for example floor, room, etc.

uuid.title: UUID
uuid.description: according to ISO/IEC 9834-8:2014; ensures globally unique identification

parentUuid.title: UUID of the master item
parentUuid.description: Indicates that the component belongs to a higher-level overall item

ebkpGateCode.title: eBKP-Gate code
ebkpGateCode.description: According to eBKP-Gate; code and label are to be given in separate data fields

ebkpGateLabel.title: eBKP-Gate label
ebkpGateLabel.description: Label belonging to the eBKP-Gate code; code and label are to be given in separate data fields

quantityMin.title: Quantity (min)
quantityMin.description: The quantity may deliberately be given as a range with a lower and an upper limit; for a precise figure enter the same value in both fields

quantityMax.title: Quantity (max)
quantityMax.description: The quantity may deliberately be given as a range with a lower and an upper limit; for a precise figure enter the same value in both fields

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: A unit suitable for placing the components with takers is recommended

quantityNotes.title: Quantity notes
quantityNotes.description: Additional information on the quantity, for example further reference quantities

zDim.title: Outer dimension height
zDim.description: The three outer dimensions are intended to standardise how dimensions are given for as many component shapes as possible; they follow the bounding box of the buildingSMART IFC standard

yDim.title: Outer dimension width
yDim.description: The three outer dimensions are intended to standardise how dimensions are given for as many component shapes as possible; they follow the bounding box of the buildingSMART IFC standard

xDim.title: Outer dimension depth / length
xDim.description: The three outer dimensions are intended to standardise how dimensions are given for as many component shapes as possible; they follow the bounding box of the buildingSMART IFC standard

dimensionNotes.title: Free dimension details
dimensionNotes.description: Relevant dimensions not covered by the outer dimensions or other attributes

description.title: Further information
description.description: Description of relevant properties not covered by the outer dimensions or other attributes

material.title: Material category
material.description: Material categories the component mainly consists of; several can be chosen, for example solid wood for the frame and glass for the glazing of a timber window

materialNotes.title: Material notes
materialNotes.description: Details on the material not covered by the material category

pollutantReport.title: Pollutant report
pollutantReport.description: States whether an assessment of contamination by a pollutant report exists for the component

visualCondition.title: Visual condition
visualCondition.description: Any remarks on the visual condition can be added in the data field «Explanation of the recommendation»

functionalCondition.title: Functional condition
functionalCondition.description: Any remarks on the functional condition can be added in the data field «Explanation of the recommendation»

demountability.title: Dismantling effort
demountability.description: Any remarks on the dismantling effort can be added in the data field «Explanation of the recommendation»

recDetailedAssessment.title: Recommendation detailed survey
recDetailedAssessment.description: The auditor of the reuse audit stage I recommends whether an in-depth survey of the component should be carried out in the reuse audit stage II

recDistribution.title: Recommendation placement
recDistribution.description: The auditor of the reuse audit stage II recommends whether placement of the component should be sought

recNotes.title: Explanation of the recommendation
recNotes.description: Any remarks on the assessment and on the recommendation to place the component

pollutantNotes.title: Pollutant notes
pollutantNotes.description: Further details on the pollutant report, for example author, date, and type and degree of contamination

connection.title: Connection type
connection.description: All connections relevant to dismantling or installing the component; additional information not covered by the selection list can be added as free text in the data field «Connection notes»

connectionNotes.title: Connection notes
connectionNotes.description: Additional information on the connection not covered by the selection list

reUseStatus.title: Reuse status
reUseStatus.description: Current state of the component in the reuse process

locationPostalCode.title: Postal code of location
locationPostalCode.description: Postal code of the current location of the component

locationCountry.title: Country of location
locationCountry.description: Country of the current location of the component as a two-letter country code according to ISO 3166-1 (e.g. CH)

storageStartDate.title: Storage start date
storageStartDate.description: Date on which the component was put into storage

storageEndDate.title: Storage end date
storageEndDate.description: Date on which the component left storage or must leave it at the latest

logisticsNotes.title: Logistics notes
logisticsNotes.description: Additional information on storage, packaging and transport of the component

availabilityStartDate.title: Availability start date
availabilityStartDate.description: Date from which the component is available to takers

availabilityEndDate.title: Availability end date
availabilityEndDate.description: Date until which the component is available to takers

price.title: Selling price
price.description: Selling price in Swiss francs per unit chosen for the quantity

handoverConditions.title: Handover conditions
handoverConditions.description: Terms of handover, for example collection from the donor building or warehouse, dismantling by the taker, deadlines

emissionSavingsPerUnit.title: GHG savings per unit
emissionSavingsPerUnit.description: According to KBOB; the approximate GHG savings from reusing the component compared with new production; the method should be described in the data field «Life cycle assessment notes»

emissionSavings.title: GHG savings
emissionSavings.description: Total GHG savings for the quantity given; method as for «GHG savings per unit»

emissionNotes.title: Life cycle assessment notes
emissionNotes.description: Remarks on the GHG balance or details of further climate and environmental indicators

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer
manufacturer.description: Name of the company that manufactured the component

productName.title: Product name
productName.description: Full product name or brand name of the component

yearOfInstallation.title: Year of installation
yearOfInstallation.description: Year in which the component was installed in the donor building

yearOfManufacture.title: Year of manufacture
yearOfManufacture.description: Year in which the component was manufactured

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Weight per unit chosen for the quantity

weatheringExposure.title: Weathering exposure
weatheringExposure.description: States whether and how strongly the component was exposed to the weather, for example indoors, outdoors sheltered, outdoors fully exposed

zoneInDonorBuilding.title: Zone in building
zoneInDonorBuilding.description: Zone or area of the donor building to which the component is assigned

materialKbob.title: Material according to KBOB
materialKbob.description: Materials of the component according to the KBOB list, with their respective shares

colorInHex.title: Colour as HEX
colorInHex.description: Colour of the component as a hexadecimal value, for example #A0522D

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.description: Details of any warranty or guarantee given on the reused component

priceOriginal.title: Original price
priceOriginal.description: Price of the component when new, in Swiss francs, where known

defects.title: Defects
defects.description: Known defects of or damage to the component

uValue.title: U-value
uValue.description: Thermal transmittance of the component according to the manufacturer or a measurement

volumeInLiters.title: Usable volume in litres
volumeInLiters.description: Usable volume of the component in litres, for example for tanks or basins

volumeInM3.title: Usable volume in cubic metres
volumeInM3.description: Usable volume of the component in cubic metres, for example for containers or silos

electricConnector.title: Electrical connection
electricConnector.description: Type of electrical connection, for example plug type or fixed connection

kitchenNorm.title: Kitchen standard
kitchenNorm.description: Dimensional standard to which kitchen units are built, for example SMS (55 cm) or EURO (60 cm)

holeSpacing.title: Hole spacing
holeSpacing.description: Distance between fixing or connection holes, measured centre to centre

activeOnPlatform.title: Active on platform
activeOnPlatform.description: States whether the component is visible on the placement platform

topOfferOnPlatform.title: Top offer on platform
topOfferOnPlatform.description: States whether the component is featured on the platform

paymentMethod.title: Payment method
paymentMethod.description: Accepted payment methods, for example invoice or advance payment

shippingMethod.title: Shipping method
shippingMethod.description: Possible ways of handover or delivery, for example collection or haulier

reservedStock.title: Reserved stock
reservedStock.description: Quantity already reserved for takers, in the chosen unit
